subject: weka bird
title: A Bird That Can't Fly Kills Rats and Robs Campers in New Zealand

scenes.text: New Zealand has a bird that can't fly, and rats should still fear it.
The weka looks like a brown chicken and weighs barely three pounds at most.
Yet it kills Norway rats, stoats, and seabirds almost as heavy as itself.
It raids nests on the ground for eggs and chicks, even penguin eggs.
And near huts, it walks right up, grabs food or small objects, and runs into the bushes.
Rangers advise not to chase it. Just watch where it goes, and collect your stuff later.

description:
The weka is a flightless New Zealand rail, about 50 to 60 cm long and up to about 1.4 kg.
It kills prey as big as stoats, Norway rats and Westland petrels, raids nests, and steals food and small objects from huts and campsites.
Would you leave your sandwich near a weka?
first_comment: Weka have been known to steal dog food straight from the bowl. What's the boldest animal thief you've met?
